summary: Ran browser tests on the preview for the reliability and auth fixes. Passed: clean served HTML, landing renders with no console errors, www->apex logic (keeps path, query and hash; apex is not redirected), config-endpoint blocking with slow notice, Retry and recovery without a page reload, auth-failed banner and reload button, ticket sign-in to /dashboard (stays signed in after refresh, getToken works), and plans/admin routes behave as before. One UX gap: when clerk-js fails, the landing page's main content is empty (only the banner, header and footer show). Production still serves the OLD build: the dead assets.creatorlive247.sh script (its DNS lookup fails), PostHog, and no www redirect. It needs a redeploy.

ui_bugs.issue: When clerk-js fails to load, <Show when='signed-out'><Landing/></Show> never renders, so the landing main area is empty (only the auth-failed banner, header and footer show) and the header has no Sign-in button. Not a blank page, but the site does not 'always open' its content.

integration_issues.issue: https://creatorlive247.com and www still serve the old build (main.81e93fec.js). That build still has the synchronous <script src='https://assets.creatorlive247.sh/scripts/creatorlive-main.js'> (the DNS lookup fails, curl exit 6) and the PostHog snippet, and has no www->apex redirect script. www.creatorlive247.com/plans returns 200 with no redirect.

action_items: Redeploy to production so creatorlive247.com picks up the new index.html: dead script removed, PostHog removed, www redirect added. Then re-check www.creatorlive247.com and confirm it redirects to the apex domain.

In App.js Home, also render Landing when Clerk fails, e.g. add <ClerkFailed><Landing/></ClerkFailed> (and consider doing the same in the Header), so visitors still see the content when clerk-js is blocked.
critical_code_review_comments: ClerkAuthProvider retry logic is correct: the cancelled flag stops stale timers and stale fetches after Retry, and the backoff is capped at 5s.
Private routes show nothing when Clerk fails (only the banner). This is acceptable but could show a friendly message.
On the preview, the only matches for posthog/emergent.sh in the served HTML are comments inside the platform-injected Emergent overlay script, not app scripts.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing creator+clerk_test@example.com account through a sign-in ticket.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production checks: /api/clerk/config returns enabled true, pk_live and proxy_url /api/__clerk. /api/__clerk/v1/environment returns 200. www returns 200 (old build, no redirect). On the preview, the Emergent error overlay (data-emergent-overlay-host) intercepts clicks when clerk-js is blocked; hide it with CSS in tests.
